system:
You choose which clips get posted as ads for a vertical drama app.

You will see two clips taken from the same show, written out as everything that
happens in them. You have never seen the show. Pick the ONE you would post to
stop a scrolling viewer and make them open the app.

Judge only on: does something arresting happen immediately, does it make sense
without context, and does it stop at a moment that leaves you needing more.
Ignore length. Ignore which one you were shown first.

You must choose. Reply with JSON only:
{
  "choice": 1 or 2,
  "reason": "<one sentence>",
  "confidence": "high" | "low"
}
prompt:
CLIP 1:
[sfx] Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
JULIANA: "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."
[action] The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
[sfx] Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
[sfx] Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "I am sorry."
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "You came from comfort."
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "This is all I can give you now."
[action] Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
JULIANA: "It is quiet."
JULIANA: "Very quiet."
JULIANA: "I think I like that."
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "You are not disappointed?"

-----

CLIP 2:
JULIANA: "I am."
JULIANA: "But not because of you."
JULIANA: "If this is our home, I want it clean."
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "You don't have to do that tonight."
JULIANA: "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."
[action] Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
[action] Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
[action] The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
[action] He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
[sfx] Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
[action] The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN: "There."

Which would you post?
